description: List a directory's files and subdirectories as a tree of names, like ls or tree, one level deep unless maxDepth is raised. Hidden entries are skipped unless includeHidden is set, and ignored ones (.gitignore matches, node_modules, dist, build, out, tmp) unless includeIgnored is set. includeSizes adds sizes and a total; stat returns dates; find_files searches by name pattern.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass unchanged for the next page. Pages slice one snapshot taken on the first call; it expires after ~60s — re-request without a cursor if rejected.

includeSizes.description: Show file sizes in the tree and a totals line of counts and bytes

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to traverse (default: 1 = top-level only; increase to recurse deeper)

maxEntries.description: Page size (default: 1000). Continue with nextCursor; an incomplete first page also carries resourceUri for the whole list.

path.description: Directory to list (default: first allowed root)

sortBy.description: Order within each directory: name (default) or size (largest first)

name: list
title: List
